note: No queryable zoning district polygon service found for Geary County or its cities. County publishes unincorporated zoning (AG, SR, R-1) as regulation PDFs and a text list. Junction City links a Zoning Map from its Community Development page, which appears to be a PDF/image map; no ArcGIS REST, WFS or download of district polygons found. ArcGIS Online and Kansas GIS (services.kansasgis.org, hub.kansasgis.org) searches returned no Geary zoning layer. Third-party sites (zoneomics, regrid) were not used as they are not official.
